description: Lists the evidence worth gathering about disrepair in a rented home, for the problems and the landlord given: what everyone should keep (dated photos, copies of every report, reference numbers, appointments and complaint letters), then what each problem needs and what each kind of landlord’s case needs. Problems: "damp" (damp or mould), "leak" (leaks or water ingress), "heating" (heating or boiler), "electrics" (unsafe electrics), "windows" (windows or doors), "pests" (pests or vermin), "structural" (structural or plaster). It asks for no personal details.

problems.description: The problems in the home, any of "damp", "leak", "heating", "electrics", "windows", "pests", "structural".
